author: xVegeta67
quote: The story is boring and the characters are awful. Jason just mumbles the whole time you can barely understand him, and he feels like he's just there, while Lucia is constantly annoying and trying to be the girl boss. Every cutscene feels empty, and you keep watching hoping something interesting happens, but it never does. The game limits you too much, and the optional tasks are so cringe and boring that nobody wants to do them. We all waited 13 years for this, and honestly, I struggled to finish the main story. I wanted to quit like three times during my playthrough and regret not doing it. The only good things about the game are the engine, graphics, and gameplay mechanics. Compared to RDR2, it feels like a huge downgrade, and I'm not buying games from Rockstar anymore.
